name: @estate/service-ai-assistant
description: AI estate assistant (M10 PR1): the isolating boundary for model providers (docs/00 feature 6, docs/01 §2.8, TB5). Retrieval is READ-ONLY tool calls over the user's own structured estate data — never a vector store, so nothing is copied into a second index whose access rules could drift from the source's. The service holds NO internal service credential in either direction and reaches its peers only by forwarding the caller's own bearer, so the process with the largest prompt-injection surface in the product can never mint authority it was not handed. Uploaded-document text and OCR output are UNTRUSTED INPUT and are never treated as instructions (docs/03 §4 TB5, risk #6). PR1 ships the spine — conversation storage, the tool surface, and a deterministic stub gateway — with no live model provider wired.
